It's been engineered to fire two arrows at once to ensure your target comes to a swift and none-too-pleasant halt.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 14 |durability = 18 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Duplex Bow}} Duplex Bows are [[Bow]]s used by skilled archers of the [[Yiga]]. They belong to the [[Yiga Clan Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s used by the Yiga.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 171}} They can be found by only two methods. The first is to infiltrate the [[Yiga Clan Hideout]] in the [[Gerudo Highlands]], where they are both abandoned and in use by several [[Yiga Footsoldier]]s. The second is to defeat the random Yiga Footsoldiers assassins that appear and take their Duplex Bow from them. Unlike other Bows, Duplex Bows have been engineered to fire two [[Arrow]]s in order to ensure targets are stunned. [[Nebb]], as part of the "[[The Weapon Connoisseur]]" [[Side Quest]], will ask [[Link]] to show him a Duplex Bow.{{Cite|Have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|duplex bow}}? Grandpa said you can't find those around here. If you get ahold of one, let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} If Link brings one back to [[Hateno Village]] for him, Nebb will be excited and thank Link with a [[Purple Rupee]].{{Cite|Isn't that the {{Color BotW|Blue|duplex bow}}? You remembered our promise! Thanks! Let me see!|Nebb|BotW}}{{Cite|Thank you! Take this as a token of my thanks!|Nebb|BotW}} Being made of wood, Duplex Bows will burn if they touch [[Fire]] or are exposed to a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s like metal Weapons do. Finally, they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_040" |Life = 18 |Power = 14 |Range = 40.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = true |RapidFireNum = 2 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Duplex Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bow * Yiga Clan Gear }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bows, Weapons, Yiga Clan Gear |items= BotW, TotK }}
